verdict.rationale: Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible local API server for inference (drop-in replacement for cloud APIs), but evidence only covers chat completions — there's no documentation of API endpoints for model downloading/import, custom assistant creation, MCP server configuration, or project/persona management, all of which are UI-driven features. Probes for an OpenAPI spec or docs.md returned 404s, reinforcing that a comprehensive API surface matching the UI isn't evidenced. missing for 10: API endpoints for assistant creation/management, model download/import via API, MCP configuration via API, published OpenAPI spec confirming full UI parity.
